tjalda.title: Tjalda.is – Happy Campsite Keflavík listing (2026 rates & services)

own.title: Happy Campers – Welcome to Happy Campsite Keflavik (blog post, 14.07.2021)

intro.value: A small campsite next to the Happy Campers rental office in Reykjanesbær, which the operator puts 6 minutes from Keflavík Airport.

winter.value: Closed in winter: tjalda.is gives the season as 1 May – 1 October.

items.label: Lodging tax per unit per night
Children
items.note: The operator's 2021 post says free for 16 and under; the 2026 tjalda.is price list does not mention children.

laundry.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

camping_card.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

electricity.value: Yes – zone B only, few connections (tjalda.is: 3; the 2021 post said 9); book electricity in advance

showers.value: Yes – toilets and showers with hot and cold water

kitchen.note: No kitchen is listed; outdoor washbasins with cold water are.

dump_station.note: Not listed on tjalda.is or the operator's post.

practical.value: Late-night arrival is possible if you pre-booked on the Parka app.
Zones A and C are for campervans without electricity; zone B is for vehicles that need power.
